sources.quote: Beta Coronae Australis, also named Alqubba, is a solitary star located in the southern constellation Corona Australis.

introduction.text: Its brightness, measured band by band, gives 602 times the Sun's luminosity at 4,607 K, so 38.553 solar radii.
